title: #61 - An Accountant Was Obtained

#61 - An Accountant Was Obtained

Chapter 61 An Accountant is in Hand

Arthur turned around and found that it was the daughter of the couple in the tavern.

"I can be your maid. I can do needlework and keep accounts." Seeing him looking at her, the little girl hurriedly promoted herself.

"Look, I sewed all my clothes myself."

Arthur glanced around and found that the couple in the tavern had left. It seemed that they didn't care much about their daughter.

"But I don't need a maid?" Arthur replied.

Just kidding, they were all big men, and it was really inappropriate to take the little girl back.

The little girl was so anxious that she almost cried, "You are an upright person, just take me in, otherwise I... I will be sold to a technical college by them."

Arthur looked at this little girl who looked like a junior high school student in his previous life. If he left her, she might really be sold by her parents.

Then she would live a life that was not human.

Thinking of this, the Lord of the Moulin Rouge felt a little uncomfortable.

"Then come with me. What's your name?"

"Hayley, my lord, thank you, thank you, may the seven gods bless you for life." The little girl hurriedly thanked him.

Arthur turned around and walked outside, catching a glimpse of Patrick's smirk.

"So you like this."

The lord of Haijiang City felt that he had discovered something incredible.

"Don't talk nonsense." Arthur denied it immediately, "I only like beautiful ones."

Arthur's mate selection standards are not high, long legs, thin waist, firm chest, hips, white skin and beautiful appearance are all fine.

As for hairstyle, he can accept big waves, princess cuts, ponytails, waist-length hair, etc.

It doesn't matter whether it's long, short, straight, or curved, as long as it's a beautiful girl or sister, Lord Arthur is not picky.

As for this Haley, take her back to be a tailor, accountant, or something.

Thinking of accounting, Arthur felt that he should find someone to manage money full-time to calculate and manage the expenses and income of his entire territory.

Haley can be observed and cultivated.

Arthur's own subordinate, the butler Amber, is actually very mediocre in ability except for his loyalty.

Let's not talk about Jules, a veteran soldier, who is not very useful except for his rich experience in surviving without money. Arthur still has to be careful that he will run away with the money.

Most of the other subordinates are farmers who grew up in the riverlands. They have not received any education and have not seen the prosperity of big towns such as King's Landing.

It is better for Arthur to do it himself than to let them keep accounts and manage money.

At least he can calculate that 0.8 and 0.5 multiplied by 0.4.

This question has stumped millions of users of a certain audio platform who have received nine years of compulsory education.

It was noon when the group walked out of the Red Castle. It was a bit too early to go back to their residence.

So they walked around the streets and alleys of King's Landing.

When passing by a tailor shop.

"Arthur, let me make you two sets of beautiful clothes!" Patrick suggested with his hand covering his nose.

"That's fine." Arthur, who was also holding his nose, glanced at Patrick's bright yellow silk clothes and decided to customize a similar one.

If the tailor's fee was not too high, he would even think of embroidering a few dragons on the clothes.

Of course, not the pterosaurs of Targaryen, but the snake bodies and deer antlers of Daxia.

Let's also feel what it feels like to "receive the mandate from heaven and live forever."

"My lords, please come in!" The shop owner, who was wearing embroidered silk clothes, was very enthusiastic, with a smile on his face, and made a gesture of inviting people in.

Although a large number of outsiders poured into King's Landing, most of them brought business to the blacksmith shop, and the tailor shop could only watch helplessly.

After all, the life of a wandering warrior depends on the armor, and he would like to pile all his wealth on it.

After a simple selection, Arthur chose the silk material he wanted and asked for the dragon pattern he wanted.

Then, after some bargaining by Hayley, the shop owner completed the transaction at 30% of the initial price.

This is a great advantage for people who have lived in big cities. Patrick, Desmond and others have no idea about the price of this kind of silk material.

Hayley, on the other hand, knew everything and bargained with a strong and shameless attitude.

After measuring Arthur's waist, height and chest circumference, the few people left.

"It costs one gold dragon and forty silver deer for this." Desmond was amazed.

He felt that the money was a bit wasteful.

Arthur ignored him. This coach was a complete hedge knight.

If you can get a free ticket, get a free ticket. If you can save money, save money.

After buying some top-quality sachets produced in Dorne, the group returned to the inn.

...

The next day, morning.

"Hayley, I have something to go out with these lords. Please clean up my room."

Arthur said this when he walked to the door of the little girl's room.

"Okay." Haley walked out of the room quickly, knelt down to the lord, and then went to Arthur's room to start working.

Arthur placed several silver deer and copper coins in several hidden corners of the room to test Haley's ability and loyalty.

If she didn't find the money in the corner, and if she did find it, she didn't give it to Arthur, then Arthur would give up the idea of letting her manage money.

The former shows that she is careless and such a person is not suitable for managing money.

The latter shows that she is greedy and even more unsuitable for managing money.

Only after passing this test, there will be several more later, and Arthur dared to let her manage some change.

After all, he and Hailey were not very familiar with each other, so they had to take their time step by step.

Today, Arthur and the others visited the Dragon's Lair in Rhaenys Hills and the famous Street of Silent Sisters.

These attractions are almost a must-see when visiting King’s Landing.

The scorch marks in the Dragon's Den were timeless and surprising, while the monks in the Street of Silent Sisters were old and boring, making Arthur shake his head.

In the era without the Internet, there was a frightening lack of entertainment items. Apart from shopping and shopping, there was basically no fun.

Shopping in Goulan is not what Arthur wants.

After all, they are all black abyss, more or less...

Well, I can’t hang it down.

In the afternoon, several people returned to the hotel at the waist of the Visenya Hills.

"Sir, I found three silver deer and a dozen copper plates in the corner of your room. Here they are for you."

As soon as he returned to his room, Arthur saw the little girl waiting for him holding money.

The lord was very satisfied with this first test.

At least in terms of carefulness and initial loyalty, Haili passed the test.

"I'll reward you with copper coins. You've done a good job. Go ahead." Arthur picked up three silver deer and waved Hailey away.

After Patrick outside the door asked Hailey to go out, he came in and said, "It's so boring. It would be great if there was a gathering of nobles."

Arthur also felt that this day was very boring. It would be great if there was a tourney practice.

After all, riding a lance is very skill-based, and he needs to practice.

At this moment, Desmond opened the door and came in.

"Knight Loras Tyrell invited us to the competition venue by the Blackwater River to have some normal martial arts exchanges."
